name: Network diagnostics to a target (Windows)
description: Runs ping, a traceroute (max 15 hops, no name lookups) and a DNS lookup against one validated host name or IP address.

params.name: target
params.label: Target host or IP
params.description: Host name or IP address to test.

output: Ping output, traceroute output and DNS answers. Exit 0; exit 2 on an invalid target or count.
